admission_sequence.action: Inspect official source metadata and rights only. Save URLs, access timestamps, exact license text, upstream attribution, redistribution conditions and hash. If rights cannot be established, this source remains unadmitted; choose a new source/version before any final performance is examined.

Write exposure inventory joining all prior source/file/date/symbol hashes, notebooks, dashboard queries and experiment receipts. The old 55 development dates and D00-D03 final endpoints are exposed. A blank access log is not proof of no exposure.

Custodian or auditable controller downloads canonical raw archives under the admitted terms; verify provider checksums where supplied and local hashes; retain all failed attempts. Public exports include data only if rights permit, otherwise source reconstruction manifest plus permissible aggregates.

On development-only metadata, confirm same task and >=2 guide diversity axes per additional panel (domain plus >=1.5x endpoint count is the concrete proposal). If not met, revise before a new public protocol version. Quantify common-shock dependence without final-loss inspection.

Freeze source/version/instrument, clocks, adjustment policy, causal sample builder, train/selection/planning/calibration and test raw-support boundaries, T, embargo and exclusions. Rights and exposure decisions precede final reserve assignment.
Bind inaccessible final data manifest/checksum or future acquisition rule and audit seal. A disclosed old reserved_confirmation label is superseded by later exposure; never inherit it.
All systems use identical endpoint IDs; record each fit/predict/evaluate access. Unlock once only after all final checkpoints/hyperparameters/epochs and expected job IDs are committed.
